text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 45 vials of idarubicin hydrochloride 1 mg/mL 20 mL with daily use of 3.6 vials, providing 12.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include idarubicin hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is limited but not in a declared shortage. The rule-based best option is to purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today. Hikma's label does not name a plant that can be placed for sourcing.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place order with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to confirm delivery timeline and update inventory projection — requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for any status change — requires no additional approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent substitutions at this time.
